# SuperTelque

> SuperTelque builds revenue systems for B2B companies. We handle lead generation, CRM implementation, RevOps, workflow automation with AI, social media management, and virtual assistance. Remote-first with offices in Wyoming, US and Lagos, Nigeria, serving clients globally.

## What We Do

- Lead generation and outbound sales campaigns using Apollo, Clay, and proven sequencing strategies
- CRM setup and sales operations across HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Close, ActiveCampaign, Monday.com CRM, Keap, and other major platforms
- Revenue Operations (RevOps) and GTM engineering: pipeline design, lifecycle stages, forecasting
- Workflow automation with n8n, Make, and Zapier, including AI-powered workflows using OpenAI and Claude
- Social media and community management across LinkedIn, X, and Instagram
- Virtual assistance covering admin duties, inbound handling, commerce management, order processing, and back-office operations

## Who We Work With

B2B founders and operators who need operational systems built, not slide decks. We work best with companies that have a repeatable offer and want to scale without adding headcount for every function.
